dtk.text: Ojutai is the dragonlord who rules the Jeskai after the Khanfall, when the dragons assault the khans, Shu Yun offers his life to Ojutai, and the clans fall.
He accepts Shu Yun's surrender, has the Jeskai ghostfire warriors executed and rewrites Jeskai records, punishing deviation from the new history as heresy.
As the Great Teacher he takes notice of the child Narset, whose mind he sees as having nearly limitless potential, and he names her Master at fifteen, the youngest he has ever named.

Narset's scrolls reveal that dragons existed before Ojutai and that he led the attack on the khans, yet Ojutai spares her, and when he asks years later what she has learned, she tells him she has learned the truth and walks away from Tarkir.
